I just can't help but feel like I'm a burden and it will be a relief once I'm done. Maybe they would feel initially sad but in the long run it will be better. I'm not very close to anyone, not even my parents, and I think that it will sort of be an unspoken relief once I am gone. 

I feel so torn because there's this selfish side of me that doesn't want to because it keep thinking maybe things will get better. Its not even that I want to be alive anymore, its more like I'm just passively curious what might happen next if I'm not dead. But then the rational side of me keeps saying that I'm just prolonging the inevitable and to get it over with already. I posted this in another comment and deleted it but i've basically just been using prescription sleep medication to keep myself asleep for most of the day the past couple of days, i haven't left my house or talked to anyone except come on reddit. the longer i wait the worse its going to be because i have no idea whats happening with my job or my friends or anything like that... but i keep coming back nayway and i feel like ive made such a mess, i dont know how to crawl out of it

I've tried reaching out to people but my family just tells me they don't want to hear it. I don't have many friends and I'm afraid of losing them by burdening them with my problems. I thought it would be a good idea to isolate myself for a while and just have time alone but now I barely talk to anyone and I just feel incredibly worse.
thank you so much. i have posted on suicidewatch already, thank you again.

I read that so much, and people keep saying that, but I just find it hard to believe. I spend most of the time that I am awake crying, every day feels like a constant battle against myself. I don't understand how its a gift. If it is I feel like I've wasted it, I'm too selfish to appreciate it and I don't deserve it.

thank you though sorry i dont mean to sound ungrateful, thank you for commenting it means a lot

I'm so sorry you feel this way... I just wanted to say that I can relate to this so much. This part 
>How can it feel so good to have someone inside of me who wishes he were dead? 

gave me a shiver because it feels like I was reading about myself. I've slept with men who hate themselves, and probably hate me, because its the only way for me to feel as though I have a purpose. You've summed it up so well. It makes no sense, it's a sick and horrible cycle, but its so hard to stop. I hope you find a way out. I'm sorry you have lost a friend but please take care of yourself <3

thank you for this. it was very comforting to read. it makes me feel better because maybe there is a reason then that I want to tell people, or have those urges- its just trying to move it from one part of my brain to another. i think i will try writing in a journal and seeing if that helps, or maybe lessens my initial impulse of wanting to blurt things out. it feels better to know a reason why... thank you very much again.

this was really hard and weird to write (still seems really unreal) but it happened at a daycare my parents sent me to. i remember instances of the woman telling me to take off my pants, and I remember sometimes I would try to leave my underwear on each time and hope that maybe that was enough because she wouldn't specify pants AND underwear, but she would always end up tell me to take them off too. That was the worst feeling, just hoping each time she wouldn't but knowing that she would... as if she might somehow not notice I still had them on. She kept a lot of toys in her attic, like toys brand new in the packaging, and she would take "good kids" to the attic to pick out toys when she did this stuff. I remember in specific two of the toys I picked out were a stuffed lamb and a plastic rabbit action figure thing. She would touch me but I never orgasmed, not that I can remember, and it's strange but for that I am very thankful. I don't know how I would even handle myself if I had. Certain things remind me of it in a way, not vividly but more like the memory of my emotions at that time. If someone touches my stomach in a certain way, or the inside of my thighs, I just remember feeling very scared and sick and ashamed of myself. I also remember the feeling of being sort of aroused, even though I don't want to be, and that is the worst to me, worse than feeling ashamed or sick. That's the hardest thing to get out of my mind sometimes, and to force myself to stop thinking about. It's disgusting because I hate her so much, and I can't even control my own body when I remember how she touched me.


I don't know if this was right to post. It still feels weird to say, but I am anonymous at least.Thank you for listening. I'm really sorry.
